name: Feasibility: Partner access to CMS / merchant admin
description:
Security-driven area — the PRD reports repeated incidents of partner credential leaks, and the existing Partner Role in admin is not widely adopted.

h2. Scope in PRD

- Access to the e-shop the partner is working on, on behalf of the merchant
- List of e-shops and add-ons the partner works on
- Deep link to e-shop admin
- WordPress admin retained for now, with the long-term aim of phasing it out

h2. To analyse

- Definition of the Partner role in CRM/CMS — how it works and who manages it (OQ-16)
- Impersonation / on-behalf-of access model: what exists today, what is missing, audit logging
- Merchant consent — how a merchant grants and revokes partner access
- Source of the partner ↔ e-shop relationship and its data quality
- Whether enforcing Partner Role can actually retire shared-credential access

h2. Output

Systems involved, integration gaps, T-shirt size, blockers, MVP / later / out-of-scope recommendation.
